# Feature map

What this project can do today, what it cannot, and where the evidence lives.
**This file is generated by hand but checked by machine**: every row must name an
artifact that exists (`scripts/check-features.mjs` runs in `npm run verify` and
in CI), so a row cannot claim a capability whose code has been deleted, and a
package cannot disappear without a row going red.

Vocabulary — the same five classes as the fidelity contract (§0 of
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`):

| class | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `exact` | observable behaviour is the same, bytes included |
| `equivalent` | same effect, different bytes or a different mechanism |
| `derived` | our decision; the foreign ecosystem has no such surface |
| `planned` | carried (parsed, annotated, reported) but not active |
| `unsupported` | refused with a reason; will not be served without a new decision |

Pins: DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` / `0.2.2-rc.2`, claude-code `2.1.329` (`f9e4d1e`),
codex plugin spec `1.0.0`.

## 1. Capability snapshot

The one number the project reports: **25 declared / 24 matched / 0 missing /
1 refused** rows in the coverage ratchet
(`packages/dsh-anyplugin-conformance/test/coverage.test.mjs`), across 14
fixtures. It only moves when a row moves; see `docs/TODO.md` for the queue behind
it.

| Claude output styles | `output-styles/<n>.md` | `equivalent` activation face / `planned` command face (row stays `planned`; carried byte-for-byte) | `fixtures/claude-output-styles`, `fixtures/claude-output-styles-activation`, D29/D37 |

## 6. What is deliberately not a feature

- **Terminal themes (F2).** No host surface; `planned` until a palette seam
  exists (upstream proposal in `docs/TODO.md`).
- **GUI chrome (F3).** The foreign side has no such artifact, so it is `derived`
  and excluded from the denominator.
- **Model identity in `agents/*.md`** (`model: sonnet`). Cannot be reimplemented
  on this runtime: the host has no alias-to-provider-model mapping (S16), so the
  face is `unsupported`; the escape layer (delegate to the real client) is the
  only path.
- **Mod `$.ui.ask`.** No host interaction to ask into; absent member by design.
